Cookie Policy

What this website stores on your device, why, and how you can control it.

Last updated: 20 November 2026

On this page
  1. The short version
  2. What are cookies?
  3. What this site uses
  4. Third-party services
  5. Managing cookies
  6. Contact

1. The short version

The OneClicq website at oneclicq.in does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. We do not build profiles of visitors or sell data. If we add analytics in future, we will update this page and ask for your consent first where the law requires it.

2. What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files that a website saves in your browser. Similar technologies include local storage, which keeps small pieces of information on your device. Both can be essential for a site to work, or used to measure and track visitors.

3. What this site uses

  • Strictly necessary only. Our own pages set no cookies. Our hosting provider and its security service may set a short-lived technical cookie to protect the site from abuse and bots. These cannot be switched off because the site would not work safely without them.
  • Forms. When you send the contact or careers form, the details go to our server and are emailed to our team. No cookie is set to do this. See our Privacy Policy for how we handle that information.

4. Third-party services

Some page content is loaded from other providers. When your browser fetches it, that provider receives your IP address and browser details, and may set its own cookies under its own policy:

  • Google Maps — the map on our Contact page. Google may set cookies when the map loads. (Google's cookie policy)
  • Google Fonts — the Manrope and Inter typefaces. No cookies are set.
  • jsDelivr — a content network that serves our layout and icon files. No cookies are set.
  • WhatsApp — only if you choose to click a WhatsApp link, which opens WhatsApp's own site or app.

5. Managing cookies

You can see, block or delete cookies in your browser settings at any time. Blocking the strictly necessary cookies may stop parts of the site, such as the forms, from working.

6. Contact

Questions about this policy? Email contact@oneclicq.com or write to OneClicq, Office No. 1427, 14th Floor, Ufairia Mall, Ek Murti Chowk, Greater Noida West, Uttar Pradesh 201318.
